meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会检查你构建或改动的界面(网页或终端)是否渲染正确:先截图/抓取终端画面做对比,再派两个独立审查分别检查设计系统/功能与视觉细节/中文文本,最后给出「好/坏」的结论。
howto.when: 在你新建或修改任何界面后,或当你问「这个页面/组件/终端界面看起来对吗」时触发;提到视觉 QA、截图对比等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 我刚改完设置页,帮我做一遍视觉 QA
say.note: Claude 会截图、派两个审查并给出好/坏结论。

say.text: 检查这个页面和参考图是否一致,重点看中文有没有被裁剪
say.note: 会先截图对比,再检查响应式与文本换行。

say.text: TUI 界面框线错位了,帮我定位问题
say.note: Claude 会通过浏览器中的真实终端渲染来检查对齐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will QA any UI you build or change (web or terminal): it captures screenshots/terminal frames for comparison, runs two independent read-only reviews (design-system/function and visual/CJK fidelity), then gives a good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you build or modify any UI, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right; also on keywords like visual QA, screenshot comparison, etc.

say_en.text: I just changed the settings page—run a visual QA on it.
say_en.note: Claude will capture screenshots, dispatch reviews, and give a verdict.

say_en.text: Check this page against the reference, especially for clipped CJK text.
say_en.note: It will diff screenshots, then run visual and responsive checks.

say_en.text: The TUI box borders are misaligned—help me locate the issue.
say_en.note: Claude will render the TUI in a real terminal and inspect alignment.
